title: On a Conjecture about Schauder-Basis Properties of the Daubechies Wavelet Packets
summary: Nielsen and Zhou (\emph{Mean size of wavelet packets}, ACHA 13 (2002), 22--34) conjectured that for every Daubechies filter of length at least four the associated wavelet packets fail to be a Schauder basis of $L^p(\mathbb{R})$ for every $p\neq2$; their own $\ell^1/\ell^\infty$ estimate only reaches extreme exponents. We prove the Schauder-basis-failure half of the conjecture in full, for every $1<p<\infty$ with $p\neq2$, in the length-four case.
